name: io.github.kefyusuf/search-memory-mcp
title: Search Memory
description: Free web search and long-term memory for AI assistants. No API keys; data stays local.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated search provider order, for example duckduckgo,marginalia,bing

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the local SQLite database for cache, memory, and index

environmentVariables.name: INGEST_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories whose files ingest_document may read; local file reading is off when unset

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a SearXNG instance with JSON output, used by the searxng provider

environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Brave Search API key; the brave provider then uses the official API instead of scraping
